main_text.p: concoctionis est omnis panis, sed talis o-mnium minus. Exuolatu edat nutrix co-hortalem gallina, aut capum, ut & phasia-num, aut perdicem tenera, anserum alas, passerculos, & turtures. Caueat ab ijs maxime quae in paludibus, aut lacubus degunt, praeter pisces saxatiles, quorum usus fre-quens huic morbo obnoxijs apprime est noxius. His omnibus poterituti, fi posfit, omnis epilepticus, & carnes bubulas, suil-las, atq; omnium animalium uiscera, & prefertim caprinu iecur, summe auersari. Ouil [?] lam quoq; carnem, ut & caprina ualde im-probat Hippocrates, lib. de Morbo sacro, quod haec animalia comitiali morbo obno-xia sint. Quod si nutricis, aut infantis, aut alius cuiusuis epileptici uenter flatu distendatur, iusculis adijciantur aliquot piperis grana, aut anisi paulum. Condiantur quoq; iura, quibus uescantur, oleribus, quae exic-candi, & attenuandi uim habeant plurima, cuiusmodi sunt thymbra, hyssopus, thy-mus & maiorana. Sinapi licet inciforiam uim habeat non paruam, tamen ipsum auer-sandum est, eo quod nonihil caput repleat. Quare cepis uesci, aut allio, aut dauco, uel smyrneo, ut replendi capitis efficaci, non
Note: the word "distendatur" is split across the line end without a printed hyphen; "prefertim" likewise (printed "pre" / "fertim").

page.notes: No marginal notes. Show-through and faint marks at the lower left are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "Ouil" (marked [?]); "poterituti" and "fi posfit" are copied as printed, with the words run together and the space missing. Printed hyphens are kept at line ends; words broken without a printed hyphen are written whole ("distendatur", "maxime", "prefertim").
